strategy.summary: The todo app (public/app.js, a client-side in-memory list served by server.js) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed and clear completed. E2E Playwright tests drive the real app through the UI and prove strike-through and the items-left count, filter contents and their pressed state, and the visibility and effect of "Clear completed".
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo (strike-through, items left count)
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (app has none; not in ticket)
assumptions: State lives in memory per page load, so each test starts from an empty list on a fresh page and creates its own todos; no shared server state exists, the real static server (server.js) is started by playwright.config.js webServer, nothing is faked.
'Struck through' is checked as the computed text-decoration line-through on the todo's text (user-visible style), not via the CSS class.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.
openQuestions: playwright.config.js serves on port 4173, the same as `npm start`, with reuseExistingServer outside CI; a running dev server could be reused. Left as-is because TestForge runs with BASE_URL=http://localhost:4173.

risks.description: Count text or clear button not updated after toggling
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2/TC6 assert exact count text and button visibility after each toggle

risks.description: Filter shows wrong items or wrong pressed state
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert exact list contents and aria-pressed for all three buttons

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or only one completed todo
risks.mitigation: TC7 uses two completed and one active todo and asserts exact remaining list

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed (struck through, items left decreases by one); unticking reverses both.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
preconditions: Fresh page with todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox checked, its text has line-through, 'Walk dog' not struck through, count reads '1 item left' (was '2 items left')

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
preconditions: Fresh page with two todos, one ticked
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration no longer line-through, count back to '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Active aria-pressed true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk']; Completed aria-pressed true, others false

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo and is pressed after switching back
preconditions: Todos one completed, one active; Completed filter selected
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog']; All aria-pressed true, others false

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
steps: Check button hidden with no completed todo
testCases.expected: Hidden, then visible, then hidden again
testCases.rationale: Refusal side: the action is unavailable when nothing is completed

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent'; first and third ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog'], count '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Ensures all (not just one) completed todos removed and active ones kept

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). No backend data; state is per page.
